user_message: It was a board call, and two of our key investors were questioning the direction of the company. They're always breathing down my neck, pushing me to perform, but this was different. They're not just asking for updates, they're actually doubting my ability to lead. I felt like I was on the hot seat, and every word I said was being scrutinized. I'm the founder, the face of the company, and if I can't deliver, the whole thing will crumble. I mean, what's the point of even having a board if they're just going to undermine my decisions? And now I'm stuck thinking about all the what-ifs, replaying the conversation in my head, wondering what I could've done differently. I just can't shake the feeling that I'm on the verge of failure, and that's all because of me.
